events.description: High volume of 50 failed login attempts detected from IP 192.168.1.100, indicating an automated credential guessing or brute-force attempt.
events.action: Block traffic from IP 192.168.1.100, reset compromised account credentials, enforce MFA, and inspect the internal host for malware.

events.description: An internal host (10.0.0.55) downloaded an unusually large volume of data (15.5 GB), which may indicate an insider threat, compromised credentials, or unauthorized data exfiltration.
events.action: Isolate host 10.0.0.55, revoke active user sessions associated with the activity, and audit the access logs to identify the compromised resources.

events.description: Internal IP 172.16.0.200 scanned 1000 ports, indicating network mapping or potential host compromise probing for open vulnerabilities.
events.action: Isolate IP 172.16.0.200, investigate the host for compromised credentials or malware, and apply firewall rules to limit internal scanning.
